criteria.cites: After s4: "never fails a run on one"; Today s2: "Under the default blocking policy a `not_met` on any frame ... blocks `satisfied`" (the behaviour this replaces)

criteria.reason: At an 80% floor, 8 core met and 4 evidence-only unproven exits satisfied; the control without evidenceOnly exits insufficient-coverage (8/12 = 66.7%), so evidence-only rows are left out of the ratio.
criteria.statement: `evidence-only` criteria are left out of the coverage ratio, so unproven evidence-only rows cannot push a run below the coverage floor
criteria.cites: domain-derived: the source says the loop "never fails a run on one" (After s4); a run whose coverage falls below the floor exits `insufficient-coverage`, so counting an unproven evidence-only row in the ratio would let it fail the run, which the source rules out

criteria.reason: Rendered report lists the evidence-only row DC-01-home--loading under Not Met marked "evidence only, never blocks" and shows it with its screenshot image in the Evidence section; header outcome stays Satisfied.

criteria.cites: domain-derived: the source keeps a generated row for every non-default frame (After s3) and records it in the success definition (After s4) rather than dropping it, and names its class "evidence-only"; a row that kept its place but captured nothing would provide no evidence, so the frame is still exercised and reported
